SQL Server DECLARE variable statements converted to application-level variable handling
Multi-statement transaction blocks broken into separate SQL statements to be executed within application transactions
Window functions (AVG, COUNT, LAG, RANK, PERCENT_RANK, MIN, MAX with OVER) kept as-is (natively supported)
Parameter bindings (@Parameter syntax) preserved (Npgsql handles conversion automatically)
ROUND, CASE expressions, JOIN operations kept as-is (standard SQL)
